# Learning objectives

At the end of this lesson, you will:

* Learn common downstream analyses of DESeq2 differential expression results.
* Use ShinyGO and clusterProfiler to run pathway enrichment analyses.
* Understand the basics of Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA) and how to interpret outputs.
